title: Race-day exact-quote research shadow sidecar
hypothesis: A research-only sidecar can read an already persisted non-odds candidate, extract the official JRA page's displayed quote source time for the exact wide pair, bind local receipt time and schedule lineage, fail closed on every contract violation, and render an idempotent paper decision without importing or activating any order path.
null_hypothesis: The sidecar cannot reliably prove candidate-before-odds ordering, exact-pair quote source and receipt timing, schedule and starter-universe validity, and append-only paper output while remaining isolated from production and order code.
racing_mechanism: The candidate remains determined by the frozen racing model, while the displayed market price near post time determines only whether the exact frozen ticket has research value. A separate read-only view permits race-day observation without allowing dashboard refresh latency or UI interaction to mutate the candidate or decision ledger.
target_population: Synthetic official-odds HTML and candidate-ledger fixtures covering valid, timestamp-missing, cutoff-late, freeze-invalid, schedule-invalid, universe-changed, wrong-pair, and duplicate-capture cases. A bounded one-card Grade-R engineering cohort is permitted only after a separate APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.
in_scope: Adapt one persisted candidate-freeze row into the approved paper-decision coordinator contract
Extract displayed JRA quote source-event minute from synthetic official-odds HTML
Bind local request start and response receipt timestamps to the exact quote
Validate exact race, wide ticket type, canonical candidate pair, schedule, starter universe, and candidate hash
Append one idempotent research shadow decision event per registered target
Render a separate read-only sidecar JSON and HTML view
Synthetic fixture tests only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Bounded one-card Grade-R engineering pilot only after APPROVED_TO_RUN
out_of_scope: Any production dashboard file or runtime modification
Any import or execution of auto_purchase, TARGET, purchase adapter, notification, or order code
Any candidate horse, pair, or ticket replacement based on odds
Any real race-day access before APPROVED_TO_RUN
Any formal BUY, stake, credential, or order transmission
Any threshold tuning, backtest, ROI calculation, or model retraining
Any use of final odds, result, payout, popularity, or post-race data as a decision input
raw_data_sources: JRA official wide-odds HTML restricted to the exact registered race
schedule record with version and source/received timestamps
starter-universe snapshots observed at candidate freeze and decision time
data_as_of: 2026-08-01; preparation uses only the registered synthetic manifest. No live page, historical outcome, final odds, payout, or real race-day row is read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate pair, candidate freeze record, schedule record, starter-universe snapshots, configuration, and fixture manifest hashes must be present and fixed
Candidate freeze persistence acknowledgement must precede odds join start
Quote source-event time and local received time must both be retained; minute-resolution source time must be declared
Quote race, wide ticket type, and canonical selection key must match the frozen candidate exactly
Every output must set formal_buy false, send_order false, and paper stake zero
The read-only sidecar must consume decision events and must not update candidate or decision records

chronological_fold_design.design: Deterministic synthetic source-time and sidecar contract cases, not a model-performance fold.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: feature snapshot <= candidate generation <= freeze persist ack < odds join <= quote source event <= quote received <= decision deadline < scheduled post
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No live or historical race-day rows may be read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.future_shadow_rule: After a separate run approval, the first real execution is a bounded one-card Grade-R engineering pilot; all expected races are recorded including failures, and no ROI evidence is produced.

purge_embargo.candidate_market_firewall: The candidate record must already exist and pass read-back hash verification before the quote adapter can start.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, popularity, or post-time information is permitted as a decision input.

primary_metric.name: synthetic_sidecar_contract_pass_rate
primary_metric.baseline: approved paper coordinator without official-page source-time adapter or separate race-day view

rejection_gate: Any candidate hash, pair, race, or ticket mutation
Any missing, ambiguous, wrong-pair, wrong-race, cutoff-late, or receipt-late quote accepted
Any invalid schedule, starter-universe change, or candidate-freeze failure accepted
Any duplicate event for the same idempotency key
Any production dashboard mutation or import of order-capable code
Any formal BUY, TARGET handoff, stake, credential, notification, or order side effect
Any real race-day data access during preparation
stop_conditions: Candidate freeze persistence cannot be proven before odds join
JRA displayed quote source time is missing or cannot be parsed unambiguously
Schedule or starter-universe lineage is absent or inconsistent
A formal_buy, send_order, or actual stake field becomes active
A production or order-capable module is imported or executed
The registered synthetic manifest hash changes
